title: Ridgeline Pro Credit Disputes Schedule — Filing Window, Resolution Maximum and Late Charge Hold
content:
The figures governing invoice disputes on a Ridgeline Pro Credit account are set per tier.

| Tier | Dispute filing window (calendar days after the invoice date) | Maximum dispute resolution days (calendar days from filing) | Disputed invoice held out of late charges and holds while open |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Pro Revolving Charge | 60 | 45 | Yes |
| Ridgeline Pro Revolving Charge Plus | 60 | 45 | Yes |
| Ridgeline Commercial Account Net 30 | 45 | 30 | Yes |
| Ridgeline Commercial Account Net 30 Select | 45 | 30 | Yes |
| Ridgeline Commercial Account Net 45 | 60 | 30 | Yes |
| Ridgeline Commercial Account Net 60 Enterprise | 90 | 30 | Yes |

## Notes

- The filing window is the number of calendar days after the invoice date within which an invoice may be disputed.
- The maximum dispute resolution days are the most days from filing within which an invoice dispute is resolved.
- On every tier a disputed invoice is left out of the past-due balance for late charges and holds while the dispute is open.
- The Commercial Account Net 45 has a longer filing window (60) than the Net 30 and Net 30 Select (45), and the same resolution maximum (30).
